Extract Parameter Estimates

Source: R/lavHelper-theta-hat.R
ThetaHat.Rd

Extracts the parameter estimates of a lavaan object, including fixed parameters, defined parameters, and equality and inequality constraints.

Usage

ThetaHat(object, est = NULL)

Arguments

object

Object of class lavaan.

est

Numeric vector. If not NULL, the parameter estimates are replaced with the supplied vector (one value for each row of the parameter table). This is used to update the values in the parameter vector using new estimates.

Value

Returns a list with the following elements

est

Parameter estimates.

par_names

Parameter names.

def

Defined parameters.

ceq

Equality constraints.

cin

Inequality constraints.

fixed

Fixed parameters.

free

Names of the free parameters.

See also

Other Lavaan Helper Functions: Lav2RAM(), RAM2Lav(), StdRAM()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

fit <- lavaan::sem(
  model = "mpg ~ b1 * wt",
  data = mtcars
)
ThetaHat(
  object = fit
)
#> $est
#>         b1   mpg~~mpg     wt~~wt 
#> -5.3444716  8.6975605  0.9274609 
#> 
#> $par_names
#> [1] "b1"       "mpg~~mpg" "wt~~wt"  
#> 
#> $def
#> logical(0)
#> 
#> $ceq
#> logical(0)
#> 
#> $cin
#> logical(0)
#> 
#> $fixed
#> [1] "wt~~wt"
#> 
#> $free
#> [1] "b1"       "mpg~~mpg"
#>
